site.name: Plant in Cambodia

home.title: The plants of Cambodia, in Khmer and English
home.intro: A free, open list of Cambodia's plants: scientific and local names, where they grow, how people use them and how threatened they are. Every fact has a source, and all the data can be downloaded and reused.
home.browseProvincesText: Plants recorded in each of Cambodia's 25 provinces.
home.aboutText: Plant in Cambodia is run by volunteers. Anyone can suggest corrections, local names and photos.
